source: 玄燁提供的《夢想藍圖 — 英文課表（2026 年 11 月 → 2031 年）》第 4、7、8 節。單元 1–3 按指定題目，單元 4–7 依同格式編寫。

overview.title: be 動詞現在式
overview.rule: I 配 am，you／複數配 are，其他單數配 is
overview.example: The patient is tired.

overview.title: 名詞單複數、a／an
overview.rule: 一個要加 a 或 an，兩個以上名詞加 s
overview.example: These are masks.

overview.title: the
overview.rule: 雙方都知道是哪一個，就用 the
overview.example: The door is open.

overview.title: 一般動詞現在式、第三人稱單數
overview.rule: 主詞是 he／she／it，動詞加 s
overview.example: She takes this medicine every day.

overview.title: 現在式的否定和疑問
overview.rule: 用 do／does，後面動詞打回原形
overview.example: Does he take any medicine?

overview.title: 現在進行式
overview.rule: 正在做：be 動詞＋動詞 ing
overview.example: The nurse is checking his blood pressure.

overview.title: be 動詞過去式
overview.rule: was 配單數，were 配 you 和複數
overview.example: She was in pain last night.

overview.title: 過去式（規則動詞）
overview.rule: 過去的事，動詞加 ed
overview.example: He walked to the bathroom.

overview.title: 過去式（不規則動詞）
overview.rule: 最常用的 40 個直接背
overview.example: He ate breakfast at seven.

overview.title: 過去式的否定和疑問
overview.rule: 用 did，後面動詞打回原形
overview.example: Did you sleep well?

overview.title: 未來式
overview.rule: will 或 be going to＋原形
overview.example: The doctor will see you soon.

overview.title: 助動詞
overview.rule: can／should／must／have to／may＋原形
overview.example: You should drink more water.

overview.title: 時間和地點的介系詞
overview.rule: 時間：at 幾點、on 哪天、in 月份年份
overview.example: Your surgery is on Monday at nine.

overview.title: 可數、不可數，some／any／much／many
overview.rule: 數得出來用 many，數不出來用 much
overview.example: How much water did you drink?

overview.title: 比較級和最高級
overview.rule: 短的字加 er／est，長的字用 more／most
overview.example: The pain is worse than yesterday.

overview.title: 疑問詞問句
overview.rule: what／where／when／how／how long／how often
overview.example: How often do you take this medicine?

overview.title: and／but／so／because
overview.rule: 用連接詞把兩句接成一句
overview.example: He is weak because he did not eat.

overview.title: when／before／after／if
overview.rule: 先後順序和條件
overview.example: Wash your hands before you eat.

overview.title: 現在完成式
overview.rule: have／has＋過去分詞，從以前到現在
overview.example: She has had a fever for two days.

overview.title: 現在完成式和過去式的差別
overview.rule: 有講明確的過去時間就用過去式
overview.example: He fell yesterday. He has fallen twice this week.

overview.title: 被動語態
overview.rule: be 動詞＋過去分詞
overview.example: The medicine was given at eight.

overview.title: 不定詞和動名詞
overview.rule: want to do／finish doing
overview.example: He wants to go home.

overview.title: there is／there are，it 當主詞
overview.rule: 「有」用 there is／are
overview.example: There is some blood on the dressing.

overview.title: 頻率和時間的說法
overview.rule: always／usually／twice a day
overview.example: Take this pill twice a day.

overview.title: 祈使句和禮貌的請求
overview.rule: Please…／Could you…／I need you to…
overview.example: Could you take a deep breath?

overview.title: 關係子句
overview.rule: who／which／that 用來補充說明
overview.example: The patient who came in last night has a fever.

overview.title: 間接問句
overview.rule: 問句放進另一句裡，順序變回一般句
overview.example: Can you tell me where it hurts?

overview.title: 過去進行式
overview.rule: 那時候正在做
overview.example: He was sleeping when I came in.

overview.title: 第一類假設（有可能發生）
overview.rule: If＋現在式，主要句用 will
overview.example: If the pain gets worse, press the call button.

overview.title: 轉述
overview.rule: He said (that)…／The patient reports…
overview.example: The patient says he feels dizzy.

overview.title: 現在完成進行式
overview.example: She has been coughing for a week.

overview.title: 過去完成式
overview.example: He had taken the pill before he came.

overview.title: 第二類假設（跟事實相反）
overview.example: If I were you, I would rest.

overview.title: 助動詞的被動
overview.example: This drug should be given with food.

overview.title: 名詞子句
overview.example: It is important that you finish the antibiotics.

overview.title: 分詞片語
overview.example: The patient lying in bed 3 needs help.

overview.title: 對比和讓步
overview.example: Although he is tired, he wants to walk.

overview.title: 因果的書面說法
overview.example: The surgery was delayed due to a fever.

overview.title: 描述數字的變化
overview.example: His blood pressure dropped from 150 to 120.

overview.title: 表達意見、把回答講長
overview.example: In my opinion…, because…, for example…

overview.title: 冠詞進階
overview.rule: 抽象名詞、專有名詞、慣用說法

overview.title: 常見搭配和片語動詞
overview.example: take a history, pass out, come down with
